p: Barion Brown will miss the Week 3 game against the Raiders with a hamstring injury.
Brown is a non-factor for Week 3, so keep him on your bench or out of your lineup.
Brown's hamstring injury came from the game and he is on the injury report.
A game-related hamstring injury puts his Week 3 availability and any receiver or returner role in question.
Will continue as the returner with a few snaps on offense.
His value is mostly as a returner with only minimal offensive usage so far, which limits fantasy value outside return-yardage formats.
He'll continue to play that role and he'll be a very important role.
